_comment: Deck-conditioning corpus. Mirror match, Qwen3-4B, temperature 1.0, append-only. Deck from mage-bench sample-decks 'Decks to Beat' -- ships with XMage so every card is guaranteed implemented; deckType Freeform because Freeform.java validates size only. Seat name kept short: server_config.xml maxUserNameLength=14 and the fan-out appends a numeric suffix. CONTROL: base notalk-strategy. MUST run with MAGEBENCH_DECISION_REMINDERS=0 -- the reminder code fires by default, so a control collected without it is a reminder arm wearing a control's name.
